The completed unmap experiment does not qualify the versioned updater. Managed source requires its own complete native acceptance run.

last_direct_layout_runtime.long_application: Both targets passed the deliberate 125-second application case: x86-64 125.157 seconds; ARM64 125.188754 seconds.
last_direct_layout_runtime.primary_unmap_probe: Both run 8 fixtures completed. Still-mapped and primary-unmapped live children denied replacement with 0xC0000022 and preserved both files. Terminated children allowed replacement with status 0.
last_direct_layout_runtime.proposed_layout: These direct-layout runs predate the approved versioned implementation. They do not qualify the managed layout.
